name: Straight kurta
note: Design parameters in mm, measured from landmarks (halfway.md, the Amber model). The default is the photographed garment: neck depth from the neckline view (neck-point line to the centre-front edge, 130.4 px x 0.3046 mm, after the StepA step 3 snap; was 40.9 mm), width = the agreed neck-l -> neck-r distance. Each view maps a CHANGE in mm to its own px (its mmPerPx and landmarks); the range must stay inside each plate's reach (plate.json neck.reachDeepMm, reachWideMm per side).

rules: lace width < neck depth (12 mm lace, 20 mm minimum depth)
corners stay on the shoulder line

garment.note: The garment record (StepB step 2): the garment's pieces and its landmarks in PIECE cm, one record for all views. u, v in cm; src: agreed (a value the atelier gave), measured (one view), fitted (several views: their mean, with the spread), assumed, definition (true by the definition of the piece's frame). A plate names the record's version and hash; the build refuses a plate whose landmarks the record does not name (views.<view>.landmarks).

front.origin: the centre front on the neck-point line (the line through neck-l and neck-r)
front.u: + toward the image right of the front views (the wearer's left)

back.origin: the centre back on the neck-point line
back.u: + toward the image right of the front views (the wearer's left)

sleeve-l.grain: the sleeve's centre line, shoulder point to cuff
sleeve-l.u: + toward the image right of the front views

sleeve-r.grain: the sleeve's centre line, shoulder point to cuff
sleeve-r.u: + toward the image right of the front views

front.note: the neck depth 39.7 mm (neck.depthMm default, the neckline view); u = 0 by definition

underarm-l.note: each view's point is the visible junction of the sleeve's inner edge and the body's side (a silhouette point); the seam's underarm point is hidden (StepB step 0)

front.note: the front length at the centre front
the hem's corner at the slit: 4 cm above the centre-front hem in the torso view (open: the photographed hem, or the torso frame's sag)

back.note: the back's hem corner = the front's (in the hem view the two are 1.5 mm apart in v)

front.note: v = hem-slit-l - the agreed slit length 240 mm (the hem view's scale); u measured in the torso view. The torso photo's slits are 9.5 and 15.9 cm

cuff-l.note: the sleeve length, shoulder -> cuff-out 470 mm (the sleeve view's agreed scale); a weft line: only v is compared
